"tekliftopla" is a popular phrase in Turkish meaning collect offers or get quotations.

tekliftopla sends request for proposal (RFP) e-mails drafted by its users to suppliers in Turkey related to the goods and services described in the RFP.

tekliftopla will only convey the RFP message and is not involved in the following stages of negotiations or agreement if any. 

Usage is free of charge.

For further information visit our web site www.tekliftopla.com .

Internet connection is required for usage.
